core_obligations: Show that the specialization diagrams commute along an extension of DVRs R'/R (proof lines 492-509). Observe X'_{K'} = X_{K'} = X_K x_{Spec(K)} Spec(K') and similarly for closed fibres, so the vertical arrows make sense as base change maps (see section-relative-fields, tag 0H4E) (proof lines 493-495). For an integral closed subscheme Z of X_K with scheme theoretic image Zbar in X: Z_{K'} is a closed subscheme of X_{K'} with scheme theoretic image Zbar_{R'} in X_{R'}, and the base change of [Z] is [Z_{K'}]_r = [Zbar_{K'}]_r by definition (proof lines 496-500); by lemma-specialization-module (tag 0H4I) sp_{X/R}([Z]) = [Zbar_kappa]_r and sp_{X'/R'}([Zbar_{K'}]_r) = [(Zbar_{R'})_{kappa'}]_r (proof lines 501-505); since (Zbar_{R'})_{kappa'} = (Zbar_kappa)_{kappa'} the two compositions agree (proof lines 506-508).
proof_roadmap: Identify the generic and closed fibres of X' with base changes of those of X so the vertical arrows are defined (proof lines 493-495).
Scheme theoretic images commute with the DVR base change, and the base-changed cycle is the cycle of the base-changed closure (proof lines 496-500).
Compute both specialization maps by the specialization-module lemma and identify the two closed-fibre cycles (proof lines 501-508).
